```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Use "content/about_ecocast.yml" instead if
# execute-dir: project is enabled in _quarto.yml.
with open("../../content/about_ecocast.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}


def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)


def md(value):
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )


def bullet_list(items):
    return "<ul>" + "".join(
        f"<li>{safe(item)}</li>" for item in items
    ) + "</ul>"


def render_links(items):
    result = ""

    for item in items:
        result += f"""
        <li>
          <a href="{safe(item.get('url'))}"
             target="_blank"
             rel="noopener noreferrer">
            {safe(item.get('name'))}
          </a>: {safe(item.get('description'))}
        </li>
        """

    return f"<ul>{result}</ul>"


def render_references(items):
    result = ""

    for item in items:
        result += f"""
        <li>
          {safe(item.get('citation'))}
          <a href="{safe(item.get('url'))}"
             target="_blank"
             rel="noopener noreferrer">
            {safe(item.get('link_label'))}
          </a>
        </li>
        """

    return f"<ul>{result}</ul>"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# CONTENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

hero = data.get("hero", {})
nav = data.get("navigation", {})
mission = data.get("mission", {})
team = data.get("team", {})
funding = data.get("funding", {})
species = data.get("species", {})
management = data.get("management", {})
why = data.get("why_it_matters", {})
additional = data.get("additional", {})
disclaimer = data.get("disclaimer", {})


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# MISSION PARAGRAPHS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

mission_paragraphs = "".join(
    f"<p>{safe(p)}</p>"
    for p in mission.get("paragraphs", [])
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# SPECIES CARDS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

species_cards = ""

for item in species.get("items", []):
    species_cards += f"""
    <article class="cw-ecocast-species-card">

      <span class="cw-ecocast-species-label">
        {safe(item.get('category'))}
      </span>

      <div class="cw-ecocast-species-image">
        <img
          src="{safe(item.get('image'))}"
          alt="{safe(item.get('alt'))}"
        >
      </div>

      <div class="cw-ecocast-species-caption">
        {md(item.get('caption'))}
      </div>

    </article>
    """


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# DYNAMIC OCEAN MANAGEMENT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

traditional = management.get("traditional", {})
dynamic = management.get("dynamic", {})

dynamic_points = ""

for point in dynamic.get("points", []):
    dynamic_points += f"<li>{safe(point)}"

    if point == "Incorporates diverse data sources:":
        dynamic_points += bullet_list(
            dynamic.get("data_sources", [])
        )

    dynamic_points += "</li>"


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------

websites = additional.get("websites", {})
references = additional.get("references", {})


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-ecocast cw-ecocast-about">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-ecocast-topbar">

    <a class="cw-ecocast-brand" href="ecocast.html">
      <img
        src="{safe(nav.get('logo'))}"
        alt="{safe(nav.get('logo_alt'))}"
      >
    </a>

    <nav class="cw-ecocast-tabs"
         aria-label="EcoCast navigation">

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab is-active"
         href="about_ecocast.html"
         aria-current="page">
        About EcoCast
      </a>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
         href="ecocast_map.html">
        EcoCast Map
      </a>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
         href="ecocast_explorer.html">
        EcoCast Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>


  <!-- INTRODUCTION -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-hero">

    <span class="cw-ecocast-about-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>


  <!-- MISSION -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-section">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-about-heading">
      <h2>{safe(mission.get('title'))}</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-mission">
      {mission_paragraphs}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- TEAM AND FUNDING -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-two-col">

    <article class="cw-ecocast-info-card">

      <h2>{safe(team.get('title'))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(team.get('introduction'))}</p>

      {bullet_list(team.get('organizations', []))}

      <p>{safe(team.get('closing'))}</p>

    </article>

    <article class="cw-ecocast-info-card">

      <h2>{safe(funding.get('title'))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(funding.get('introduction'))}</p>

      {bullet_list(funding.get('organizations', []))}

    </article>

  </section>


  <!-- SPECIES -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-section">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-about-heading">
      <h2>{safe(species.get('title'))}</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-species-grid">
      {species_cards}
    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- DYNAMIC OCEAN MANAGEMENT -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-section">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-about-heading">
      <h2>{safe(management.get('title'))}</h2>
    </div>

    <p class="cw-ecocast-management-intro">
      {safe(management.get('introduction'))}
    </p>

    <h3 class="cw-ecocast-comparison-heading">
      {safe(management.get('comparison_title'))}
    </h3>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-comparison-grid">

      <article class="cw-ecocast-comparison-card traditional">

        <h3>{safe(traditional.get('title'))}</h3>

        {bullet_list(traditional.get('points', []))}

      </article>

      <article class="cw-ecocast-comparison-card dynamic">

        <h3>{safe(dynamic.get('title'))}</h3>

        <ul>{dynamic_points}</ul>

      </article>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- WHY IT MATTERS -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-why">

    <h2>{safe(why.get('title'))}</h2>

    <p>{safe(why.get('description'))}</p>

    <h3>{safe(why.get('highlight_title'))}</h3>

    {bullet_list(why.get('points', []))}

  </section>


  <!-- ADDITIONAL INFORMATION -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-section">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-about-heading">
      <h2>{safe(additional.get('title'))}</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-about-accordion">

      <details class="cw-ecocast-about-details">

        <summary>
          {safe(websites.get('title'))}
          <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </summary>

        <div class="cw-ecocast-about-details-body">
          {render_links(websites.get('items', []))}
        </div>

      </details>

      <details class="cw-ecocast-about-details">

        <summary>
          {safe(references.get('title'))}
          <span aria-hidden="true">+</span>
        </summary>

        <div class="cw-ecocast-about-details-body">
          {render_references(references.get('items', []))}
        </div>

      </details>

    </div>

  </section>


  <!-- DISCLAIMER -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-disclaimer">
    {md(disclaimer.get('text'))}
  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
